scope: Complete direct named chronology accessor fan-out: reaction_confirmation, reset_time, order_b_reset_event_time, _bridge_reaction_confirmation, plus source provider contracts. First bounded W2 partition only, not all Reaction/Reset lifecycle or Blue/A freeze.

discovery.method: Read all 15 direct engine/pipeline and engine/bridge Python modules at pinned main; exact SHA matched recursive main tree for each. Scan line text for four named call forms excluding def declarations; inspect each direct occurrence and surrounding owner predicates. 20 distinct path/line/target keys matched. Not an AST/dynamic-dispatch census; indirect wrappers and further transitive owner rules outside this bounded partition.

providers.contract: main_index right-bisect minus one, only underflow optionally clamps to zero, no upper-bound check; lower_bounds left-bisect both endpoints, missing end len(seconds). Reset key includes index/from_first, second/display/timestamp/broken-level string; cached non-None wins, then truthy second_time parsed, else truthy display parsed, else timestamp. Confirmation key direction/flag/First/Break/box strings/conditional intrabar start; valid intrabar start in [Break open,end), otherwise Break open; false disables intrabar start. Strict high>top bullish else low<bottom, first row in half-open bounds; no hit returns and caches Break open. Fallback not proof.

Upper horizon last selected main timestamp+tf exclusive, no lower-bound gate in helper. Null level/time or time >= horizon -> None. bisect_left exact timestamp; examine all duplicate timestamp rows until strict hit or timestamp changes. bearish high>level else low<level. Reaction proof passes opposite direction to stop predicate; never substitutes a later/earlier event. Stop view separately gates main stop time. A fallback coinciding with actual strict timestamp can pass predicate, so no blanket claim that every fallback is null.
